name: Abihu
bio: Abihu is Aaron's second son, who along with his brother Nadab and seventy elders of Israel was called up Mount Sinai, bowing down to God from a distance and being granted the rare privilege of "seeing the God of Israel" and eating and drinking in His presence (Exodus 24:1, 9-11). Later, however, Abihu joined Nadab in offering "strange fire" before the LORD and was consumed by fire from the LORD — an account told in detail in Leviticus.
